title: File:Ranghar - Assam 01.jpg
author: anas shaikh
description: The rang Ghar (Pron:/ˌɹæŋ ˈgɑː/, Assamese: ৰংঘৰ, rong ghor meaning "House of Entertainment") is a two-storied building which once served as the royal sports-pavilion where Ahom kings and nobles were spectators at games like buffalo fights and other sports at Rupahi Pathar (pathar meaning "field" in Assamese) - particularly during the Rangali Bihu festival in the Ahom capital of Rangpur.
period_note: Surviving masonry predominantly 18th century; not direct evidence for a 15th-century palace
classification_note: Classified from source title/category; not a full visual authentication.
